articles.title: Fauci Was Wrong About 'Almost Every Single Pandemic Policy': Former FDA Insider Breaks Silence
articles.summary: Vinay Prasad, a former FDA insider turned outspoken critic, tells Reason magazine that Anthony Fauci was wrong about nearly every major COVID-19 policy he championed — from lockdowns to masking to school closures. This comes as public health institutions hemorrhage credibility and face unprecedented scrutiny over pandemic-era decision-making. Prasad's indictment is specific, credentialed, and damning — exactly the kind of dissent that was systematically silenced during the pandemic.

articles.title: Brownstone Institute Asks the Question No One in Public Health Will Answer: Why Weren't We Warned?

The piece forces a reckoning with how health authorities weaponized selective disclosure, withholding data that contradicted the approved narrative. The question of who knew what and when remains unanswered by the agencies that owe the public accountability.

articles.title: Political Meddling in Medicine Is Destroying Your Health Freedom — And the Data Proves It
articles.summary: Mercola.com republishes a landmark analysis documenting how political interference in hospital systems and health institutions during the COVID-19 pandemic eroded public trust and medical autonomy. The piece catalogs how approved narratives were enforced while dissenting physicians faced professional retaliation and censorship. Trust in hospitals has collapsed — not because of misinformation, but because the institutions themselves abandoned scientific integrity.

articles.title: Vitamin D Research the Mainstream Won't Touch: International Forum Exposes What the Guidelines Are Hiding
articles.summary: The 2024 International Virtual Vitamin D Forum presented evidence on vitamin D's broad systemic roles — from immune modulation to disease prevention — that continues to be dismissed or underfunded by establishment bodies like the NIH. Despite mounting peer-reviewed evidence, official dietary guidelines have refused to meaningfully update their recommendations, leaving the public underinformed and under-supplemented. This is nutrition science suppression playing out in real time.

articles.title: Longevity Science Has a Women Problem — And the Influencer Industrial Complex Is Making It Worse
articles.summary: Physicians are raising alarms that popular longevity protocols — from prolonged fasting to aggressive supplementation regimens — were designed exclusively around male physiology and are being uncritically promoted to women without evidence of safety or efficacy. The longevity space, largely funded outside traditional research structures, has outrun the science and is now actively ignoring sex-based biological differences that could cause real harm. This is what happens when independent research operates without accountability.

articles.title: Texas Forces Children's Hospital to Open Detransition Clinic After $10M Settlement — The Medical Establishment Is Furious
articles.summary: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton's historic legal settlement with Texas Children's Hospital has compelled the institution to open the first detransition clinic in the country, serving patients seeking care after gender-transition interventions — a patient population that mainstream medicine has actively refused to acknowledge or study. The $10 million penalty and mandated clinic represent a legal forcing function against an institution that suppressed clinical outcomes data on pediatric transition. Detransitioners finally have a facility; the establishment has no answer for why it took a lawsuit to create it.

articles.title: ENO2-Driven Glycolysis in Liver Cancer: Metabolic Research the Oncology Mainstream Keeps Sidelining
articles.summary: New peer-reviewed research in PLOS ONE identifies ENO2-driven glycolytic reprogramming as a key driver of hepatocellular carcinoma progression — directly implicating tumor metabolism in cancer development in ways that challenge the dominant gene-mutation-centric model. This metabolic theory of cancer aligns with suppressed research traditions that trace malignancy to mitochondrial dysfunction rather than purely genetic causes. The oncology establishment's continued neglect of metabolic mechanisms delays treatment innovation and costs lives.

articles.title: Theranos 2.0? Elizabeth Holmes' Partner Is Running a Blood-Testing Startup With No Product and Big Promises
articles.summary: Fortune reports that Billy Evans, partner of convicted Theranos fraudster Elizabeth Holmes, is operating a blood-testing startup called Haemanthus — complete with patents, investors, and a mysteriously absent CTO — but no actual product. The parallels to Theranos are not subtle: a charismatic founder, proprietary health tech claims, and a conspicuous absence of independent validation. The FDA's failure to proactively scrutinize this operation, given the documented history, raises serious questions about regulatory capture and institutional memory.

This is what health system capture looks like when the budget ax finally falls on the most vulnerable.
